tonight.headline: Golden is a 16:45 decision, and Pickens has a new hamstring
body: Bad news first: Matthew Golden is questionable tonight (shoulder, foot) — limited Wednesday after missing Tuesday's walkthrough, and LaFleur's answer on whether he plays was 'I sure hope so.' His fallback, George Pickens, was limited Wednesday with a hamstring added to the shoulder. Bloodsports are 1-6.
The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 126.6 to 121.2, 53%. Check Green Bay's inactives at 16:45 CDMX: if Golden is out, start Pickens in his slot. Jacobs and Golden lock at 18:15.

case.label: The other side
case.body: Metcalf Gala start Amon-Ra St. Brown, who missed Wednesday with the ankle — Campbell expects him ready (DK Network 28 Oct) — and bench Olave on a Saints bye.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Golden inactive and the swap not made: about 15 projected points become zero in a 5.4-point game.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · inactives Thu 29 Oct 16:45 CDMX
doFirst.title: If Golden is inactive, Pickens takes his WR slot
doFirst.subtitle: Questionable, limited Wednesday. Check inactives at 16:45 CDMX tonight — and Pickens now carries a hamstring too.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Shoulder and foot. DNP in Tuesday's walkthrough, limited Wednesday; questionable, and LaFleur said 'I sure hope so' when asked if he plays (National Football Post 28 Oct). He briefly left the Detroit game before returning. The foot is new this week (PlayerProfiler).

case.label: The fallback
case.body: George Pickens, 14.0 — 1.1 below Golden, inside the coin-flip line, so nothing is lost by playing safe if Golden sits. But Pickens was limited Wednesday with shoulder and hamstring (Machota via CBS 28 Oct), and Dallas may give him a designation.

case.label: The clock
case.body: Inactives 90 minutes before the 18:15 kickoff: 16:45 CDMX. Golden's slot locks at kickoff; Pickens plays Sunday 12:00, so if he is then ruled out, Rashee Rice (limited Wednesday, Sunday 15:25) can still take the slot.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Golden is active and Pickens outscores him (archive) — the contingency was right to exist but the tag was noise. If Golden sits, untestable.

whatWentWrong.title: Golden is still questionable — and Green Bay play Thursday
whatWentWrong.lead: Shoulder and foot; limited Wednesday after a walkthrough DNP. LaFleur: 'I sure hope so.'

case.label: What happened
case.body: He played through the shoulder in Week 7 (12 targets, archive) and briefly left that game; the foot is new this week (National Football Post 28 Oct).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Do-first fallback: Pickens if he is inactive at 16:45 Thursday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Golden is active and plays a full share — then the questionable tag was precautionary.
